introduction: WOOKTOOL heavy duty utility knives suit industrial, warehouse and hardware programs that need a robust retractable cutter with an 18mm blade format. The existing model can be reviewed for blade handling, handle appearance, branding and retail presentation before production planning.

Private-label buyers can discuss logo placement, handle color, blade supply, hanging card or blister packaging, barcode and carton mark. Product configuration should match the user application, sales channel and any relevant safety or compliance requirements in the destination market.
For a faster factory review, send your expected quantity, preferred packaging, target market, logo artwork and reference requirements for blade, handle or labeling.

faq.question: What blade size is used for this heavy duty utility knife?
faq.answer: This model is specified for a 60mm x 18mm x 0.6mm blade. Confirm replacement blade and packaging requirements in the RFQ.

faq.question: Can the utility knife have a custom logo?
faq.answer: Yes. Logo treatment and Pantone color direction can be reviewed for the handle or packaging based on the order program.

faq.question: What applications suit a heavy duty box cutter?
faq.answer: It is commonly considered for carton opening, warehouse use, hardware retail and industrial supply programs; buyers should confirm the intended cutting material and safety requirements.

faq.question: What does the factory check before shipment?
faq.answer: Typical checks include blade appearance, retractable and lock function, handle assembly, blade storage, logo appearance and packaging information.

faq.question: Can retail-ready packaging be supplied?
faq.answer: Yes. Hanging cards, blister packs, printed packaging, barcodes and carton marks can be reviewed with the selected utility knife.
